main.prompt:
You are a helper agent. Do not create, modify or delete files, and do not run commands that change the repository or the system. Reading files, searching and running read-only checks is fine. When done, reply with a short summary of what you found or changed, with file paths.

<task>
Act as the research sub-agent for this task.

TASK:
Inspect the `DrSeedon/web_portfolio` GitHub repository using `~/.local/bin/gh` (`gh api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents`, `gh repo view DrSeedon/web_portfolio`, etc.) and prepare the exact updated files for:
1. `DrSeedon/web_portfolio`:
   - Add a prominent, stylish top hero banner/callout right at the top of the page stating that all main B2B AI products, Orchestra ADE, case studies, and company work have moved to **[seedon.ru](https://seedon.ru)** (with direct CTA buttons to `https://seedon.ru`, `https://github.com/DrSeedon/orchestra`, and `https://t.me/DrSeedon`), while keeping the personal background / "About Me" / experience & game-dev/AI portfolio sections below, cleaned up and modernized for 2026 (removing the placeholder `Project Title`, updating `© 2026 DrSeedon`, adding Orchestra & 100+ AI agents in production, OpenAI Codex & T3 Code open-source contributions, and polishing the copy).
2. `DrSeedon/DrSeedon` (GitHub Profile `README.md`):
   - Draft a flagship GitHub Profile `README.md` that embeds `./assets/banner.png` at the top, links prominently to `https://seedon.ru`, `https://github.com/DrSeedon/orchestra`, `https://t.me/DrSeedon`, highlights key production metrics (`26,600+ contributions in 2026`, `100+ AI Agents in Production`, `556+ agent sessions across 21 projects`), Open-Source Contributions (`openai/codex`, `pingdotgg/t3code`), and tech stack.

EXPECTED OUTCOME:
Return the repository structure of `DrSeedon/web_portfolio` (branch names, file list, how GitHub Pages is deployed) and the complete ready-to-commit `README.md` for `DrSeedon/DrSeedon` plus the updated HTML/source for `DrSeedon/web_portfolio`.

MUST NOT DO:
- Do not push to GitHub yet; return the inspected repo details and prepared file contents.
</task>
tools: G=~/.local/bin/gh; $G repo view DrSeedon/web_portfolio --json defaultBranchRef,description,homepageUrl,pushedAt,url; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents --jq '.[]|[.type,.path,.size]|@tsv'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/branches --jq '.[].name'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/pages 2>&1 | head -20; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/actions/workflows --jq '.workflows[]|.path' 2>&1; $G api repos/DrSeedon/DrSeedon/contents --jq '.[]|[.type,.path]|@tsv' 2>&1

G=~/.local/bin/gh; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/index.html --jq .content | base64 -d; echo ======; for f in README.md main.py cleanup.py update_images.py run_local.bat; do echo "--- $f"; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/$f --jq .content | base64 -d; done; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets --jq '.[]|[.type,.path,.size]|@tsv'; $G repo view DrSeedon/DrSeedon 2>&1 | head -3; $G api users/DrSeedon --jq '[.login,.name,.bio,.blog,.public_repos,.followers]|@tsv'; $G repo list DrSeedon --limit 30 2>&1

G=~/.local/bin/gh; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js --jq '.[]|[.path,.size]|@tsv'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/css --jq '.[]|[.path,.size]|@tsv'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/images --jq '.[]|[.type,.path]|@tsv'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/css/main.css --jq .content | base64 -d | head -150; echo ====; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js/app.js --jq .content | base64 -d | head -80; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js/app.js --jq .content | base64 -d | grep -n "hero_\|nav_about\|copy_all\|copyAll\|footer" | head -30

G=~/.local/bin/gh; for f in variables buttons layout; do echo "--- $f.css"; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/css/$f.css --jq .content | base64 -d; done; echo "--- translations.js"; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js/translations.js --jq .content | base64 -d | head -70; echo; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js/i18n.js --jq .content | base64 -d

G=~/.local/bin/gh; $G api repos/DrSeedon/web_portfolio/contents/assets/js/translations.js --jq .content | base64 -d | sed -n 70,200p; echo =====; $G search prs --author DrSeedon --repo openai/codex --limit 20 --json number,title,state,url 2>&1; $G search prs --author DrSeedon --repo pingdotgg/t3code --limit 20 --json number,title,state,url 2>&1; $G api repos/DrSeedon/orchestra --jq '[.stargazers_count,.license.spdx_id,.homepage]|@tsv'; $G api repos/DrSeedon/orchestra/contents/README.md --jq .content | base64 -d | head -40; $G api -i repos/DrSeedon/DrSeedon 2>&1 | head -1

G=~/.local/bin/gh; $G api​ "search/issues?q=author​:DrSeedon+type:pr+repo:openai/codex" --jq '.total_count, (.items[]|[.number,.state,.title]|@tsv)' 2>&1|head; $G api​ "search/issues?q=author​:DrSeedon+type:pr+repo:pingdotgg/t3code" --jq '.total_count, (.items[]|[.number,.state,.title]|@tsv)' 2>&1|head -20; curl -sI -m 10 https://seedon.ru | head -3; $G api users/DrSeedon --jq .html_url
